3-group-1.audio.2.1.textEn: Our new subsidiary needs a versatile reception system.

3-group-1.audio.2.2.textEn: The sales representative keeps trying to tout the premium package, but most of its features are peripheral to what we need.

3-group-1.audio.3.2.textEn: Ease of use should be the main criterion.
3-group-1.audio.3.2.textZh: 易用性应该是主要标准。

3-group-1.audio.3.3.textEn: The basic package lets visitors register and prints badges without extra equipment.
3-group-1.audio.3.3.textZh: 基础套餐可以让访客登记并打印访客证，无需额外设备。

3-group-1.audio.4.2.textEn: Still, I do not want to incur an installation fee we have overlooked.
3-group-1.audio.4.2.textZh: 不过，我不想因为疏忽而多付安装费。

3-group-1.audio.5.1.textEn: I will request a written quotation that includes setup and training.

3-group-1.audio.5.2.textEn: Then we can compare the total costs before signing anything.

4-group-1.audio.2.1.textEn: Good afternoon, and welcome to the inaugural session of the Harbor Arts Forum.
4-group-1.audio.2.1.textZh: 下午好，欢迎参加港湾艺术论坛的首场活动。

4-group-1.audio.2.2.textEn: Our ebullient host, Elena Ruiz, will introduce the speakers at two.
4-group-1.audio.2.2.textZh: 我们热情洋溢的主持人埃莱娜·鲁伊斯将在两点介绍演讲嘉宾。

4-group-1.audio.2.3.textEn: The main presentation explores the intrinsic value of local arts, rather than treating attendance figures as the only measure of success.
4-group-1.audio.2.3.textZh: 主旨演讲将探讨本地艺术本身的价值，而不把出席人数当作衡量成功的唯一标准。
4-group-1.audio.2.3.noteZh: intrinsic value 指事物本身的价值。

4-group-1.audio.2.4.textEn: We hope to elicit candid suggestions from the audience, so please use the cards on your seats to submit questions.
4-group-1.audio.2.4.textZh: 我们希望听到各位坦诚的建议，请用座位上的卡片提交问题。

4-group-1.audio.2.5.textEn: A volunteer will collect them during the break.
4-group-1.audio.2.5.textZh: 休息期间会有志愿者收取卡片。

4-group-1.audio.2.6.textEn: Although our original speaker is unavailable, her substitute has agreed to lead the discussion.
4-group-1.audio.2.6.textZh: 原定演讲嘉宾无法出席，接替她的嘉宾已同意主持讨论。

4-group-1.audio.2.7.textEn: The workshop will culminate in a short planning session at four, when participants can propose projects for next year.
4-group-1.audio.2.7.textZh: 研讨会最后会在四点安排一场简短的规划会，届时与会者可以提出明年的项目建议。

7-passage-group-1.passage.1.3.textEn: The restored cinema hosts The Last Signal on November 7.
7-passage-group-1.passage.1.3.textZh: 翻修后的影院将于 11 月 7 日放映《最后的信号》。

7-passage-group-1.passage.1.4.textEn: The story follows a fugitive attempting to clear her name; organizers describe it as suspense rather than a morbid account of violence.
7-passage-group-1.passage.1.4.textZh: 影片讲述一名在逃女子试图洗清冤屈的故事，主办方称这是一部悬疑片，而非渲染暴力的猎奇故事。

7-passage-group-1.passage.1.5.textEn: The screening begins at 7 p.m., followed by a discussion with the director.
7-passage-group-1.passage.1.5.textZh: 影片将于晚上 7 点开始放映，随后安排与导演交流。

7-passage-group-1.passage.1.6.textEn: Cameras are prohibited during the film.
7-passage-group-1.passage.1.6.textZh: 放映期间禁止使用相机。

7-passage-group-1.passage.1.7.textEn: An accredited paparazzo or other press photographer may work only in the lobby and must obtain permission before photographing guests.
7-passage-group-1.passage.1.7.textZh: 持有采访证的狗仔或其他新闻摄影师只能在大厅工作，拍摄来宾前必须获得许可。

7-passage-group-1.passage.1.8.textEn: The event aims to resurrect interest in local filmmaking.
7-passage-group-1.passage.1.8.textZh: 活动旨在重新激发人们对本地电影创作的兴趣。

7-passage-group-1.passage.1.9.textEn: The director's next project is a sequel, but no release date has been announced.
7-passage-group-1.passage.1.9.textZh: 导演的下一个项目是这部电影的续集，但上映日期尚未公布。

7-passage-group-1.passage.1.10.textEn: Bookings cost $18 and include the discussion.
7-passage-group-1.passage.1.10.textZh: 预订票价为 18 美元，包含交流环节。

7-passage-group-1.passage.1.11.textZh: 学生出示证件后可享 12 美元票价。

7-passage-group-1.passage.1.12.textEn: Uncollected tickets are released fifteen minutes before the film.
7-passage-group-1.passage.1.12.textZh: 未领取的门票将在开场前 15 分钟重新发售。

7-passage-group-1.passage.1.13.textEn: The evening celebrates storytelling, not the hedonistic lifestyle depicted by some of its characters.
7-passage-group-1.passage.1.13.textZh: 当晚活动旨在庆祝讲故事的艺术，而非推崇片中某些角色的享乐主义生活方式。

q29.audio.2.1.textZh: A.  我们有一个双层房间。

q29.audio.3.1.textEn: B. Customer service can handle that.
q29.audio.3.1.textZh: B. 客户服务可以处理。

q29.audio.4.1.textEn: C. A paltry amount of rainfall.

q30.audio.1.1.textEn: Would you mind giving me a candid assessment?
q30.audio.1.1.textZh: 你介意给我一个坦率的评估吗?

q30.audio.2.1.textEn: A. The camera is behind you.

q30.audio.3.1.textEn: B. It will be assessed tomorrow at noon.
q30.audio.3.1.textZh: B. 将于明天中午评估。

q30.audio.4.1.textEn: C. I think the proposal still needs work.
q30.audio.4.1.textZh: C.  我认为，该提案仍然需要工作。

q31.audio.1.1.textEn: Could the team meet simultaneously in both offices?
q31.audio.1.1.textZh: 小组能否在两个办公室同时开会?

q31.audio.2.1.textEn: A. They are in the vicinity.

q31.audio.3.1.textEn: B. There is one office chair left.
q31.audio.3.1.textZh: B.  还剩一张办公室椅子

q31.audio.4.1.textEn: C. A video conference would make that possible.
q31.audio.4.1.textZh: C. 举行电视会议是有可能的。

q33.stem.1.textEn: What feature do the speakers consider most important?
q33.stem.1.textZh: 发言者认为最重要的特征是什么?

q34.stem.1.textEn: What will the second speaker do next?
q34.stem.1.textZh: 第二位发言者接下来将做什么?

3-group-2.audio.1.1.textEn: Questions 35 through 37 refer to the following conversation.
3-group-2.audio.1.1.textZh: 第 35 至 37 题根据以下对话作答。

3-group-2.audio.2.1.textEn: Marta, a small blemish on the metal panel has led to a customer complaint.
3-group-2.audio.2.1.textZh: 玛塔，金属面板上的一个小问题导致顾客投诉。

3-group-2.audio.2.2.textEn: I was about to compensate the buyer, but the quality team wants to probe the cause first.
3-group-2.audio.2.2.textZh: 我本来要补偿买家的但质量小组想先调查原因

3-group-2.audio.3.2.textEn: The alloy itself looks fine; the protective coating seems to have failed during transport.
3-group-2.audio.3.2.textZh: 合金本身看起来很好；防护涂层似乎在运输过程中失败了。

3-group-2.audio.4.1.textEn: Could rough handling tarnish the surface that quickly?
3-group-2.audio.4.1.textZh: 粗糙的处理会很快地玷污地表吗?

3-group-2.audio.5.2.textEn: Let us keep the damaged panel here and send a replacement now.
3-group-2.audio.5.2.textZh: 我们把损坏的面板留在这现在派个替补人员

3-group-2.audio.5.3.textEn: We can ask the courier for its handling records while the laboratory examines the coating.
3-group-2.audio.5.3.textZh: 我们可以在实验室检查涂层时请信使提供处理记录。

3-group-2.audio.6.2.textEn: I will call the buyer and explain the plan.
3-group-2.audio.6.2.textZh: 我会打电话给买主解释计划

q36.stem.1.textEn: What does the second speaker recommend?
q36.stem.1.textZh: 第二位发言者有何建议?

q36.option.B.1.textEn: Providing a replacement before the inquiry is finished
q36.option.B.1.textZh: 在调查结束前提供替代人员

q36.option.D.1.textZh: 重新为最近的命令提供资金

q37.stem.1.textEn: Why will the first speaker contact the buyer?
q37.stem.1.textZh: 第一位发言者为何要与买方联系?

q37.option.A.1.textEn: To explain how the complaint will be handled

q37.option.D.1.textEn: To request a laboratory job application

3-group-3.audio.1.1.textEn: Questions 38 through 40 refer to the following conversation.
3-group-3.audio.1.1.textZh: 第 38 至 40 题根据以下对话作答。

3-group-3.audio.2.1.textEn: The ventilation contractor says the new filters are ready, but dust will still penetrate the room unless we replace the seal around the door.
3-group-3.audio.2.1.textZh: 通风承包商说新过滤器已经准备好，但灰尘仍然会穿透房间，除非我们更换门周围的封条。

3-group-3.audio.3.1.textEn: Then ordering the filters alone would be a facile solution.
3-group-3.audio.3.1.textZh: 那么单点滤波器就太简单了

3-group-3.audio.3.2.textEn: We should address the whole problem.
3-group-3.audio.3.2.textZh: 我们应该解决整个问题。

3-group-3.audio.4.2.textEn: They say it is imperative to finish before Friday, when the testing equipment arrives.
3-group-3.audio.4.2.textZh: 他们说，在测试设备到达后，必须在星期五之前完成。

3-group-3.audio.5.1.textEn: The contractor can replace the seal Wednesday morning.
3-group-3.audio.5.1.textZh: 承包商可更换星期三上午的封条。

3-group-3.audio.5.2.textEn: We need to designate someone to unlock the building at seven.
3-group-3.audio.5.2.textZh: 我们需要指定一人在七点给大楼开门。

3-group-3.audio.6.1.textZh: 我住在附近我住在附近我住在附近我住在附近

3-group-3.audio.6.2.textEn: I can do that, and I will warn the staff that the room will be unavailable until noon.
3-group-3.audio.6.2.textZh: 我可以做到这一点，我将警告工作人员，房间将在中午之前不开放。

q38.stem.1.textEn: Where most likely do the speakers work?
q38.stem.1.textZh: 发言者最可能在哪里工作?

q39.stem.1.textEn: Why does the work need to be completed this week?
q39.stem.1.textZh: 为什么本周的工作需要完成?

q40.stem.1.textEn: What does the second speaker offer to do?
q40.stem.1.textZh: 第二位发言者愿意做什么?

q40.option.A.1.textEn: Collect the filters from a factory

q40.option.C.1.textEn: Give the contractor access to the building

3-group-4.audio.1.1.textEn: Questions 41 through 43 refer to the following conversation.
3-group-4.audio.1.1.textZh: 第 41 至 43 题根据以下对话作答。

3-group-4.audio.2.1.textEn: Our debut cooking class is full.
3-group-4.audio.2.1.textZh: 我们的首次烹饪课已经满了

3-group-4.audio.2.2.textEn: The instructor wants a piquant soup as the first recipe, but several guests have requested a less spicy entree.
3-group-4.audio.2.2.textZh: 教官想先吃点辣汤作为食谱，但有几位客人要求少点辣菜。

3-group-4.audio.3.1.textEn: We can cater to both groups.
3-group-4.audio.3.1.textZh: 我们可以照顾两个团体。

3-group-4.audio.3.2.textEn: Prepare a mild base and put the seasonings on a separate tray.
3-group-4.audio.3.2.textZh: 准备一个温和的基座，并把调料放在一个单独的托盘上。

3-group-4.audio.3.3.textEn: Everyone can choose their own level of heat.
3-group-4.audio.3.3.textZh: 每个人都可以选择自己的热量水平。

3-group-4.audio.4.2.textEn: That should make the soup palatable without changing the lesson.
3-group-4.audio.4.2.textZh: 这应该能让汤美味，而不改变教训。

3-group-4.audio.5.1.textEn: Also, the ingredient list on the booking page omits sesame oil.
3-group-4.audio.5.1.textZh: 另外，预订页上的成分列表省略了芝麻油。

3-group-4.audio.5.2.textEn: It is important for guests with allergies.
3-group-4.audio.5.2.textZh: 这对过敏的客人很重要。

3-group-4.audio.6.1.textEn: I will update the page and email the list to everyone this afternoon.
3-group-4.audio.6.1.textZh: 我今天下午将更新网页，并发电子邮件给大家。

3-group-4.audio.6.2.textEn: Could you buy the extra bowls?

q41.stem.1.textEn: What are the speakers preparing for?

q42.stem.1.textEn: How will different preferences be accommodated?

q43.stem.1.textEn: What will the first speaker do this afternoon?
q43.stem.1.textZh: 第一位发言者今天下午将做什么?

3-group-5.audio.1.1.textEn: Questions 44 through 46 refer to the following conversation.
3-group-5.audio.1.1.textZh: 第 44 至 46 题根据以下对话作答。

3-group-5.audio.2.1.textEn: The municipal office approved our outdoor premiere, but a throng could block the emergency exit.
3-group-5.audio.2.1.textZh: 市政府批准我们户外首映但一阵子就能封锁紧急出口了

3-group-5.audio.2.2.textEn: We must not let an upsurge in ticket sales put anyone in jeopardy.
3-group-5.audio.2.2.textZh: 我们决不能让售票量激增给任何人带来危险。

3-group-5.audio.3.1.textEn: We can segregate the entry queue from the exit route with temporary barriers.
3-group-5.audio.3.1.textZh: 我们可以用临时屏障从出站路线中分离出进站队列。

3-group-5.audio.3.2.textEn: The statutory occupancy limit still applies even outdoors.
3-group-5.audio.3.2.textZh: 即使在户外，法定占用期限也仍然适用。

3-group-5.audio.4.1.textEn: Would that deter people from arriving early?
3-group-5.audio.4.1.textZh: 那会阻止人们提前到达吗?

3-group-5.audio.5.2.textEn: It simply keeps a clear path.
3-group-5.audio.5.2.textZh: 它只是保持一条清晰的道路。

3-group-5.audio.5.3.textEn: We should explain the arrangement in the confirmation email instead of adding it at the last minute.
3-group-5.audio.5.3.textZh: 我们应该在确认邮件中解释这个安排，而不是在最后一刻添加它。

3-group-5.audio.6.2.textEn: Please ask the site manager where the barriers can be stored overnight.
3-group-5.audio.6.2.textZh: 请询问站点管理器在一夜之间可以存储哪些屏障。

q44.stem.1.textEn: What concern does the first speaker raise?
q44.stem.1.textZh: 第一位发言者有什么关切?

q44.option.B.1.textEn: The performance might be too short

q44.option.D.1.textEn: An emergency route could become blocked
q44.option.D.1.textZh: 紧急通道可能会被封锁

q45.stem.1.textEn: What is suggested to improve safety?
q45.stem.1.textZh: 提出什么加强安全的建议?

q45.option.C.1.textEn: Separating the queue from the exit

q46.stem.1.textEn: What will the second speaker be asked to find out?
q46.stem.1.textZh: 第二位发言者将被要求知道什么?

3-group-6.audio.1.1.textEn: Questions 47 through 49 refer to the following conversation.
3-group-6.audio.1.1.textZh: 第 47 至 49 题根据以下对话作答。

3-group-6.audio.2.1.textEn: I am worried the new gadget will become obsolete within a year.
3-group-6.audio.2.1.textZh: 我担心新装备在一年内就会过时。

3-group-6.audio.2.2.textEn: The distributor calls it an ingenious design, but there is no spare battery.
3-group-6.audio.2.2.textZh: 发行商称其为"巧妙的设计"，但没有多余的电池。

3-group-6.audio.3.2.textEn: A glowing testimonial cannot substitute for a reliable maintenance plan.
3-group-6.audio.3.2.textZh: 发光的证言不能取代可靠的维修计划。

3-group-6.audio.4.1.textEn: Our current device still works, though its software is bewildering.
3-group-6.audio.4.1.textZh: 我们目前的设备仍然有效，尽管它的软件令人困惑。

3-group-6.audio.4.2.textEn: Would a training session be enough?

3-group-6.audio.5.2.textEn: Before we procure replacements, let us ask support to demonstrate the functions we actually use.
3-group-6.audio.5.2.textZh: 在我们获得替换之前，让我们请求支持，以展示我们实际使用的功能。

3-group-6.audio.6.1.textEn: I will arrange a demonstration for Tuesday.
3-group-6.audio.6.1.textZh: 我会安排星期二的示威

3-group-6.audio.6.2.textEn: If that solves the problem, we can postpone the purchase.
3-group-6.audio.6.2.textZh: 如果解决了这个问题，我们可以推迟购买。

q47.stem.1.textEn: Why is the first speaker hesitant about a product?
q47.stem.1.textZh: 为什么第一位发言者对产品犹豫不决?

q47.option.A.1.textEn: It cannot connect to the internet
q47.option.A.1.textZh: 它不能连接到互联网上

q47.option.C.1.textZh: 它的颜色是不受欢迎的

q48.stem.1.textEn: What does the second speaker imply about testimonials?
q48.stem.1.textZh: 第二位发言者对证词意味着什么?

q48.option.A.1.textZh: 他们总是有虚假的说法

q48.option.C.1.textEn: They replace the need for training
q48.option.C.1.textZh: 他们取代了训练的需要

q48.option.D.1.textEn: They are insufficient to establish long-term support
q48.option.D.1.textZh: 它们不足以建立长期支助

q49.stem.1.textEn: What will the speakers do before purchasing devices?
q49.stem.1.textZh: 发言者在购买设备之前会做什么?

q49.option.C.1.textEn: Evaluate a demonstration of their current equipment
q49.option.C.1.textZh: 评估其现有设备的演示

3-group-7.audio.1.1.textEn: Questions 50 through 52 refer to the following conversation.
3-group-7.audio.1.1.textZh: 第 50 至 52 题根据以下对话作答。

3-group-7.audio.2.1.textEn: The distinguished pianist has agreed to play at our retirement dinner.
3-group-7.audio.2.1.textZh: 尊贵的钢琴家同意在我们退休晚宴上演奏。

3-group-7.audio.2.2.textEn: Her recital fee is reasonable, but she needs a quiet room to warm up.
3-group-7.audio.2.2.textZh: 她的独奏费是合理的，但她需要一个安静的房间来暖和。

3-group-7.audio.3.1.textEn: The hotel has a small suite beside the ballroom.
3-group-7.audio.3.1.textZh: 酒店在舞厅旁边有一个小套房。

3-group-7.audio.3.2.textEn: It would give her some tranquility away from the hustle-bustle in the lobby.
3-group-7.audio.3.2.textZh: 这会让她远离大堂的皮条客感到镇定

3-group-7.audio.4.2.textEn: We also need to check whether formal attire is required.
3-group-7.audio.4.2.textZh: 我们还需要检查是否需要正式的服装。

3-group-7.audio.4.3.textEn: The invitation says elegant, which is rather obscure.
3-group-7.audio.4.3.textZh: 请柬上写的是优雅的， 相当模糊。

3-group-7.audio.5.1.textEn: I will call the organizer and ask for precise wording.
3-group-7.audio.5.1.textZh: 我将打电话给组织者，要求确切措辞。

3-group-7.audio.5.2.textEn: Then we can send a clarification with the revised itinerary.
3-group-7.audio.5.2.textZh: 然后，我们可以发出一个澄清与订正的行程。

3-group-7.audio.6.1.textEn: Please also confirm whether the pianist needs transport from the station.
3-group-7.audio.6.1.textZh: 也请确认钢琴家是否需要从车站出发的交通工具。

q50.stem.1.textEn: What event are the speakers organizing?
q50.stem.1.textZh: 发言者们正在组织什么活动?

q51.stem.1.textEn: Why is a separate room suggested?
q51.stem.1.textZh: 为什么建议单独开个房间?

q51.option.C.1.textEn: To provide a quiet practice space

q52.stem.1.textEn: What information will the second speaker clarify?
q52.stem.1.textZh: 第二位发言者将澄清哪些信息?

3-group-8.audio.1.1.textEn: Questions 53 through 55 refer to the following conversation.
3-group-8.audio.1.1.textZh: 第 53 至 55 题根据以下对话作答。

3-group-8.audio.2.1.textEn: A counterfeit ticket appeared at the tournament yesterday.
3-group-8.audio.2.1.textZh: 昨天的锦标赛上出现了一张假票

3-group-8.audio.2.2.textEn: Security wants us to confiscate suspicious tickets, but I do not want volunteers to upbraid innocent visitors.
3-group-8.audio.2.2.textZh: 保安部门要我们没收可疑的罚单但我不想让志愿者对纯洁的来访者造成伤害

3-group-8.audio.3.1.textEn: They should stay cordial and refer cases to a supervisor.
3-group-8.audio.3.1.textZh: 他们应该保持友善，把案件交给主管。

3-group-8.audio.3.2.textEn: A nasty accusation could cause a bigger problem than the ticket.
3-group-8.audio.3.2.textZh: 恶毒的指控可能会引起比罚单更大的问题。

3-group-8.audio.4.1.textEn: We can also use the scanner to check the serial number before making a decision.
3-group-8.audio.4.1.textZh: 我们还可以使用扫描仪在作出决定前检查序列号。

3-group-8.audio.5.2.textEn: Please put that process in a leaflet for the morning briefing.
3-group-8.audio.5.2.textZh: 请将此过程作为上午简报的传单。

3-group-8.audio.6.2.textEn: We should keep one entrance available for people who need assistance, so a disputed ticket does not delay everyone else.
3-group-8.audio.6.2.textZh: 我们应该为需要帮助的人保留一个入口，所以有争议的罚单不会拖延其他人的时间。

q53.option.B.1.textEn: The discovery of a false ticket

q54.stem.1.textEn: How should volunteers handle questionable tickets?
q54.stem.1.textZh: 志愿者应如何处理可疑的罚单?

q54.option.D.1.textEn: Ask a supervisor to review them

q55.stem.1.textEn: What will the second speaker prepare?
q55.stem.1.textZh: 第二位发言者将准备什么?

3-group-9.audio.1.1.textEn: Questions 56 through 58 refer to the following conversation.
3-group-9.audio.1.1.textZh: 第 56 至 58 题根据以下对话作答。

3-group-9.audio.2.1.textEn: The finance team is not immune to a surge in travel costs.
3-group-9.audio.2.1.textZh: 财务小组也未能幸免旅费的激增。

3-group-9.audio.2.2.textEn: We may default on our hotel deposit if the reimbursement arrives late.
3-group-9.audio.2.2.textZh: 如果偿还款迟到我们可能会拖欠旅馆的押金

3-group-9.audio.3.1.textEn: Could we use the provisional budget approval?
3-group-9.audio.3.1.textZh: 我们能使用临时预算批准吗?

3-group-9.audio.3.2.textEn: It gives us a small reprieve until the final figures are confirmed.
3-group-9.audio.3.2.textZh: 它给了我们一个小小的缓期执行直到最后的数字得到确认。

3-group-9.audio.4.2.textEn: I do not want to obfuscate the situation by calling the deposit an equipment expense.
3-group-9.audio.4.2.textZh: 我不想通过将存款称为设备费用来混淆这一状况。

3-group-9.audio.5.2.textEn: I will prepare a candid note explaining the cash-flow gap.
3-group-9.audio.5.2.textZh: 我将编写一份坦率的说明，解释现金流动缺口。

3-group-9.audio.5.3.textEn: We can ask for the signature before lunch.
3-group-9.audio.5.3.textZh: 我们可以在午餐前要求签名

3-group-9.audio.6.2.textEn: That will also leave an accurate record for the audit.
3-group-9.audio.6.2.textZh: 这也将为审计工作留下准确的记录。

q56.stem.1.textEn: What difficulty do the speakers face?

q56.option.C.1.textEn: A hotel has lost a reservation

q57.stem.1.textEn: What is required to use provisional funding?
q57.stem.1.textZh: 使用临时资金需要什么?

q57.option.B.1.textEn: The hotel must lower its price

q58.stem.1.textEn: Why does the first speaker reject a proposed accounting label?
q58.stem.1.textZh: 为什么第一位发言者拒绝提议的会计标签?

q58.option.B.1.textEn: It would reveal a trade secret
q58.option.B.1.textZh: 它会揭示一个商业秘密

q58.option.D.1.textEn: It would increase the room rate
q58.option.D.1.textZh: 那会提高房间的收费率

3-group-10.audio.1.1.textEn: Questions 59 through 61 refer to the following conversation.
3-group-10.audio.1.1.textZh: 第 59 至 61 题根据以下对话作答。

3-group-10.audio.2.1.textEn: I have to recuperate after my operation, so I cannot guide next week's excursion.
3-group-10.audio.2.1.textZh: 手术后我必须恢复， 所以我不能指导下周的游览。

3-group-10.audio.3.2.textEn: Does the itinerary involve a strenuous trek?
3-group-10.audio.3.2.textZh: 行程是否包括艰难的旅程?

3-group-10.audio.3.3.textEn: I have only led the urban walking tour before.
3-group-10.audio.3.3.textZh: 我之前只领导过城市步行之旅

3-group-10.audio.4.2.textEn: It is a short stroll through the suburb and a visit to the botanical garden.
3-group-10.audio.4.2.textZh: 它是一个短暂的漫步穿过郊区和参观植物园。

3-group-10.audio.4.3.textEn: The visitors are interested in exotic plants, not climbing.
3-group-10.audio.4.3.textZh: 参观者对异域植物感兴趣，而不是攀登。

3-group-10.audio.5.2.textEn: Send me the route and the contact details for the lodge.
3-group-10.audio.5.2.textZh: 把小屋的路线和联系方式发给我

3-group-10.audio.6.1.textZh: 我今晚会发邮件给他们

3-group-10.audio.6.2.textEn: Please remind everyone to bring water, since the forecast is muggy.
3-group-10.audio.6.2.textZh: 请提醒大家带水， 因为预测是粗糙的。

q59.stem.1.textEn: Why does the first speaker need help?
q59.stem.1.textZh: 为什么第一位发言者需要帮助?

q61.stem.1.textEn: What will be sent to the second speaker?
q61.stem.1.textZh: 将向第二位发言者发送什么信息?

3-group-11.audio.1.1.textEn: Questions 62 through 64 refer to the following conversation.
3-group-11.audio.1.1.textZh: 第 62 至 64 题根据以下对话作答。

3-group-11.audio.2.1.textEn: Our brewery tour visitors keep asking why we ferment this batch longer.
3-group-11.audio.2.1.textZh: 我们的酿酒厂参观者一直问为什么我们发酵这批时间更长。

3-group-11.audio.2.2.textEn: Could you articulate the reason without too much technical terminology?
3-group-11.audio.2.2.textZh: 你能用太多的技术术语来说明原因吗?

3-group-11.audio.3.2.textEn: Extra time gives the drink a mellow flavor.
3-group-11.audio.3.2.textZh: 额外的时间给饮料一种美食的味道。

3-group-11.audio.3.3.textEn: I can compare it with the sharper batch we made last month.
3-group-11.audio.3.3.textZh: 我可以和上个月的批量比较一下

3-group-11.audio.4.2.textEn: The brochure is a little vapid; it talks about excellence without explaining anything.
3-group-11.audio.4.2.textZh: 这本小册子有点模糊；它讲的是优异之处，却不作任何解释。

3-group-11.audio.5.1.textEn: I will add a short paragraph and avoid claims that might delude readers.
3-group-11.audio.5.1.textZh: 我将增加一个简短的段落，避免可能欺骗读者的说法。

3-group-11.audio.5.2.textEn: The distiller next door has a good plain-language guide; perhaps they will show us their approach.
3-group-11.audio.5.2.textZh: 隔壁的蒸馏器有一个很好的通俗的指南；也许他们会向我们展示他们的方法。

3-group-11.audio.6.1.textEn: Let us ask, but make sure we do not plagiarize their text.
3-group-11.audio.6.1.textZh: 让我们问一下，但要确保我们不篡改他们的文字。

q62.stem.1.textEn: What is the first speaker requesting?
q62.stem.1.textZh: 第一位发言者要求什么?

q62.option.A.1.textEn: A clear explanation for tour visitors

q63.stem.1.textEn: What benefit of extra time is mentioned?
q63.stem.1.textZh: 提到额外时间有什么好处?

q64.stem.1.textEn: What does the first speaker caution against?
q64.stem.1.textZh: 第一位发言者警告注意什么?

q64.option.A.1.textZh: 邀请参观者进入酿酒厂

3-group-12.audio.1.1.textEn: Questions 65 through 67 refer to the following conversation.
3-group-12.audio.1.1.textZh: 第 65 至 67 题根据以下对话作答。

3-group-12.audio.2.1.textEn: The recreation center has received a donation for aerobics equipment.
3-group-12.audio.2.1.textZh: 娱乐中心收到了用于气动设备的捐赠。

3-group-12.audio.2.2.textEn: We could use part of it for the marathon training group as well.
3-group-12.audio.2.2.textZh: 马拉松训练组也得用一部分

3-group-12.audio.3.1.textEn: The donor's implicit expectation was broader access, not a private program.
3-group-12.audio.3.1.textZh: 捐助者的隐含期望是扩大访问范围，而不是一个私人方案。

3-group-12.audio.3.2.textEn: We should avoid letting our fondness for running influence the decision.
3-group-12.audio.3.2.textZh: 我们应避免让自己喜欢的竞选影响这个决定。

3-group-12.audio.4.1.textEn: What about a rotation of classes?

3-group-12.audio.4.2.textEn: Beginners could use the room on Mondays, and runners on Wednesdays.
3-group-12.audio.4.2.textZh: 初学者周一可以使用房间，周三可以使用跑车。

3-group-12.audio.5.2.textEn: We should also consult the dietitian about a nutrition workshop.
3-group-12.audio.5.2.textZh: 我们还应该就营养问题征求饮食学家的意见。

3-group-12.audio.6.1.textEn: I will invite her to next week's planning meeting.
3-group-12.audio.6.1.textZh: 我将邀请她参加下周的计划会议。

3-group-12.audio.6.2.textEn: She may have suggestions for people who are returning to exercise after an injury.
3-group-12.audio.6.2.textZh: 她可能对受伤后返回锻炼的人有建议。

q65.option.B.1.textEn: How to appoint a new donor

q65.option.C.1.textEn: How to sell a sports center
q65.option.C.1.textZh: 如何出售一个体育中心

q65.option.D.1.textEn: How to choose a race winner

q66.stem.1.textEn: What does the second speaker want to ensure?
q66.stem.1.textZh: 第二位发言者希望确保什么?

q67.stem.1.textEn: Who will be invited to a meeting?

3-group-13.audio.1.1.textEn: Questions 68 through 70 refer to the following conversation.
3-group-13.audio.1.1.textZh: 第 68 至 70 题根据以下对话作答。

3-group-13.audio.2.1.textEn: The customer asked for a holistic review of the service problem.
3-group-13.audio.2.1.textZh: 客户要求全面审查服务问题。

3-group-13.audio.2.2.textEn: An apology alone will not vindicate our handling of the case.
3-group-13.audio.2.2.textZh: 仅靠道歉并不能证明我们处理此案的正确性。

3-group-13.audio.3.2.textEn: The missed appointment was a mishap, but our repeated failure to reply made it worse.
3-group-13.audio.3.2.textZh: 错过的预约是一场灾难，但我们一再未能答复，使情况更加糟糕。

3-group-13.audio.4.2.textEn: It would be remiss to blame a junior employee as a scapegoat when our notification system failed.
3-group-13.audio.4.2.textZh: 在我们的通报系统失败时责备一个初级员工作为替罪羊是失职的

3-group-13.audio.5.1.textEn: I have already arranged a replacement appointment for Friday.
3-group-13.audio.5.1.textZh: 我已经安排周五的替补预约了

3-group-13.audio.5.2.textEn: I will also test the reminder system today and give the customer my direct number.
3-group-13.audio.5.2.textZh: 我今天也会测试提醒系统并给客户我的直接号码。

3-group-13.audio.6.2.textEn: Please include those steps in the reconciliation meeting notes.
3-group-13.audio.6.2.textZh: 请将这些步骤列入和解会议说明。

q68.stem.1.textEn: What is the main purpose of the conversation?
q68.stem.1.textZh: 谈话的主要目的是什么?

q68.option.B.1.textEn: To improve the response to a service complaint
q68.option.B.1.textZh: 改进对服务投诉的回应

q69.stem.1.textEn: What does the first speaker oppose?
q69.stem.1.textZh: 第一位发言者反对什么?

q69.option.D.1.textEn: Blaming one employee for a system failure
q69.option.D.1.textZh: 将一个员工归咎于系统故障

q72.stem.1.textZh: 与会者应如何提出问题?

q73.stem.1.textEn: What is scheduled for four o'clock?

4-group-2.audio.1.1.textEn: Questions 74 through 76 refer to the following talk.
4-group-2.audio.1.1.textZh: 第 74 至 76 题根据以下讲话作答。

4-group-2.audio.2.1.textEn: This is a message for the tenants of Brook Avenue.
4-group-2.audio.2.1.textZh: 这是给布鲁克大道的房客的讯息

4-group-2.audio.2.2.textEn: The municipal authority will enact a temporary restriction on access to our street tomorrow while workers repair a sewage pipe.
4-group-2.audio.2.2.textZh: 市政当局将颁布一项临时限制令，禁止工人在明天修排污管道时进入我们的街道。

4-group-2.audio.2.3.textEn: The work is intended to lessen the risk of contamination and will run from eight until noon.
4-group-2.audio.2.3.textZh: 这项工作旨在降低污染风险，将从八点持续到中午。

4-group-2.audio.2.4.textEn: Please do not trespass beyond the marked barriers or attempt to wade through standing water.
4-group-2.audio.2.4.textZh: 请不要越过有标记的屏障，或试图通过站立的水。

4-group-2.audio.2.5.textEn: A convoy of maintenance vehicles will need the whole lane, so vehicles parked there must be moved tonight.
4-group-2.audio.2.5.textZh: 维修车辆车队需要整条车道所以今晚必须把停在那里的车辆搬走

4-group-2.audio.2.6.textEn: We realize this puts a crimp in your morning plans.
4-group-2.audio.2.6.textZh: 我们意识到这让你的早间计划有点小麻烦

4-group-2.audio.2.7.textEn: A shuttle from the north entrance will connect residents to the main bus stop, and the building office has printed details.
4-group-2.audio.2.7.textZh: 从北门出发的穿梭车将连接居民与主客车站，建筑办公室有印刷细节。

q74.stem.1.textEn: Why will access to the street be restricted?

q75.stem.1.textEn: What must vehicle owners do tonight?

q76.stem.1.textEn: What assistance is offered to residents?
q76.stem.1.textZh: 向居民提供了哪些援助?

q76.option.A.1.textZh: 前往公共汽车站的交通

4-group-3.audio.1.1.textEn: Questions 77 through 79 refer to the following talk.
4-group-3.audio.1.1.textZh: 第 77 至 79 题根据以下讲话作答。

4-group-3.audio.2.1.textEn: Welcome aboard the research vessel Meridian.

4-group-3.audio.2.2.textEn: On this voyage we will observe pelagic birds beyond the harbor.
4-group-3.audio.2.2.textZh: 在这次航行中，我们将观察港外的远洋鸟类。

4-group-3.audio.2.3.textEn: The latitude and longitude of each observation will be recorded automatically, so visitors need only note the species and approximate count.
4-group-3.audio.2.3.textZh: 每次观测的纬度和经度会自动记录，因此参观者只需要注意物种和大致的计数。

4-group-3.audio.2.4.textEn: The captain expects a light breeze this afternoon, but precipitation may arrive before we return.
4-group-3.audio.2.4.textZh: 船长预计今天下午会有轻微微风，但降水可能会在返航前到达。

4-group-3.audio.2.5.textEn: Please stow cameras inside waterproof bags when you are not using them.
4-group-3.audio.2.5.textZh: 相机不用时，请放入防水袋内。

4-group-3.audio.2.6.textEn: The optics equipment belongs to the research team and must not be adjusted without permission.
4-group-3.audio.2.6.textZh: 光学设备属于研究组的，不得擅自调整。

4-group-3.audio.2.7.textEn: We encourage spontaneous questions, but keep the passageway clear.
4-group-3.audio.2.7.textZh: 我们鼓励自发的问题，但保持通道清晰。

4-group-3.audio.2.8.textEn: Anyone with jet lag or motion sickness may rest in the lower cabin; a crew member can escort you there.
4-group-3.audio.2.8.textZh: 任何有飞机时滞或运动疾病的人可以在下层机舱休息；乘务员可以护送你到那里。

q77.stem.1.textEn: What is the purpose of the voyage?

q78.stem.1.textEn: What information must visitors record themselves?
q78.stem.1.textZh: 访客必须记录哪些信息?

q78.option.A.1.textEn: The species and number of birds

q79.stem.1.textEn: What are visitors told about optical equipment?
q79.stem.1.textZh: 关于光学设备，游客们怎么说的?

q79.option.A.1.textEn: It can be rented at the harbor

q79.option.B.1.textEn: It must be returned before lunch
q79.option.B.1.textZh: 午餐前一定要还回来的

q79.option.C.1.textEn: Permission is needed to adjust it

q79.option.D.1.textEn: It is included in the ticket price

4-group-4.audio.1.1.textEn: Questions 80 through 82 refer to the following talk.
4-group-4.audio.1.1.textZh: 第 80 至 82 题根据以下讲话作答。

4-group-4.audio.2.1.textEn: This is the monthly update from Northbridge Housing.
4-group-4.audio.2.1.textZh: 这是来自北桥住宅的每月更新。

4-group-4.audio.2.2.textEn: A derelict factory on the outskirts of town will be converted into an affordable residence complex.
4-group-4.audio.2.2.textZh: 城郊废弃的工厂将改建为可负担的住宅建筑群。

4-group-4.audio.2.3.textEn: The developer will restore the facade and retain the original clock tower as part of the area's industrial legacy.
4-group-4.audio.2.3.textZh: 开发者将修复外观，保留原有的钟楼，作为该地区工业遗产的一部分。

4-group-4.audio.2.4.textEn: A monolithic building had been proposed, but the revised plan uses smaller blocks around a shared garden.
4-group-4.audio.2.4.textZh: 曾提出过一座单层建筑，但修订后的计划使用更小的街区环绕一个共享的花园。

4-group-4.audio.2.5.textEn: The project is not a panacea for the housing shortage, yet it should add eighty apartments.
4-group-4.audio.2.5.textZh: 这个项目不是解决住房短缺的灵丹妙药，但它应该增加80套公寓。

4-group-4.audio.2.6.textEn: A public meeting will take place in the old dormitory on June twelve.
4-group-4.audio.2.6.textZh: 6月12日将在旧宿舍举行公开会议。

4-group-4.audio.2.7.textEn: Please send questions in advance; the bureau will publish written responses afterward, including an explanation of how the rural bus service will connect to the complex.
4-group-4.audio.2.7.textZh: 请提前发问；局会公布事后的书面答复，包括农村公交服务将如何与综合体连接的解释。

q80.stem.1.textEn: What will be created at the factory site?

q81.stem.1.textEn: What part of the site will be preserved?
q81.stem.1.textZh: 该网站的哪个部分将保留下来?

q82.stem.1.textEn: What are listeners encouraged to do before the meeting?
q82.stem.1.textZh: 鼓励听众在会议之前做些什么?

4-group-5.audio.1.1.textEn: Questions 83 through 85 refer to the following talk.
4-group-5.audio.1.1.textZh: 第 83 至 85 题根据以下讲话作答。

4-group-5.audio.2.2.textEn: Our exhibition on the renaissance of handwoven textiles closes on Sunday.
4-group-5.audio.2.2.textZh: 我们手织纺织品复兴展览周日闭幕。

4-group-5.audio.2.3.textEn: It features contemporary apparel alongside older pieces, showing how a once moribund craft found new patronage.
4-group-5.audio.2.3.textZh: 它的特点是当代服装与旧的作品并列，表明曾经沉没的工艺是如何找到新的赞助品的。

4-group-5.audio.2.4.textEn: Please do not touch the delicate fabric, even when the display looks like a garment that could be worn.
4-group-5.audio.2.4.textZh: 请不要触摸微妙的织物， 即使显示看起来像一件衣服可以穿。

4-group-5.audio.2.5.textEn: A conservator will explain how humidity can cause natural fibers to deteriorate during a free talk at three.
4-group-5.audio.2.5.textZh: 保存者会解释湿度如何在三点的自由谈话中导致自然纤维恶化。

4-group-5.audio.2.6.textEn: The temperature is monitored with a thermometer near the entrance, but visitors should not adjust the controls.
4-group-5.audio.2.6.textZh: 入口附近用温度计监测温度，但访客不应调整控制。

4-group-5.audio.2.7.textEn: Our shop has a small composition book with notes from the exhibition.
4-group-5.audio.2.7.textZh: 我们的店里有一本小构思书里面有展览的笔记

4-group-5.audio.2.8.textEn: Purchases support the restoration fund, and members receive a ten percent discount.
4-group-5.audio.2.8.textZh: 购买支持修复基金，会员享受10%的折扣。

q83.option.B.1.textEn: The revival of a textile craft

q84.stem.1.textEn: What will be discussed at three?

q84.option.A.1.textEn: The design of a new entrance

q84.option.B.1.textEn: Damage to fibers caused by moisture
q84.option.B.1.textZh: 水分对纤维造成的损害

q84.option.D.1.textEn: A change in museum opening hours
q84.option.D.1.textZh: 博物馆开放时间的变化

q85.option.B.1.textEn: A reduction in the shop price

4-group-6.audio.1.1.textEn: Questions 86 through 88 refer to the following talk.
4-group-6.audio.1.1.textZh: 第 86 至 88 题根据以下讲话作答。

4-group-6.audio.2.1.textEn: Thank you for attending today's workplace conduct training.
4-group-6.audio.2.1.textZh: 谢谢你参加今天的工作场所操控训练

4-group-6.audio.2.2.textEn: A truculent response to criticism can turn a minor disagreement into a vicious exchange.
4-group-6.audio.2.2.textZh: 对批评的轻率反应，可以把小的分歧变成恶毒的交换。

4-group-6.audio.2.3.textEn: Managers should not goad colleagues into defending themselves or use rhetoric that reinforces prejudice against an ethnic minority.
4-group-6.audio.2.3.textZh: 管理人员不应欺骗同事为自己辩护或使用强化对少数民族偏见的言辞。

4-group-6.audio.2.4.textEn: Our aim is to pacify disputes through fair procedures, not to force staff to capitulate to the loudest voice.
4-group-6.audio.2.4.textZh: 我们的目标是通过公平程序来平息争端，而不是迫使工作人员屈服于最响亮的声音。

4-group-6.audio.2.5.textEn: If a concern cannot be resolved privately, submit it to the employee relations office.
4-group-6.audio.2.5.textZh: 如果一项关切不能私下解决，请提交雇员关系办公室。

4-group-6.audio.2.6.textEn: The office's jurisdiction includes internal conduct complaints but excludes disputes with external suppliers.
4-group-6.audio.2.6.textZh: 该办公室的管辖权包括内部行为投诉，但不包括与外部供应商的争议。

4-group-6.audio.2.7.textEn: A revised guide will be emailed this evening.
4-group-6.audio.2.7.textZh: 一份订正指南今晚将发电子邮件。

4-group-6.audio.2.8.textEn: Read the examples before Friday's follow-up session, where we will practice giving feedback without personal accusations.
4-group-6.audio.2.8.textZh: 在星期五后续会议之前阅读这些例子，我们将在不提出个人指控的情况下进行反馈。

q86.stem.1.textEn: What is the training intended to improve?
q86.stem.1.textZh: 培训的目的是如何改进?

q87.stem.1.textEn: Which concern falls outside the office's responsibility?
q87.stem.1.textZh: 哪个问题不属于办公室的责任范围?

q87.option.A.1.textZh: 团队内部的不公平反馈

q87.option.D.1.textEn: A dispute with an external supplier

q88.stem.1.textEn: What should participants do before Friday?
q88.stem.1.textZh: 与会者在星期五之前应做什么?

4-group-7.audio.1.1.textEn: Questions 89 through 91 refer to the following talk.
4-group-7.audio.1.1.textZh: 第 89 至 91 题根据以下讲话作答。

4-group-7.audio.2.1.textEn: Here is the forecast for the Ridge Recreation Area.
4-group-7.audio.2.1.textZh: 以下是岭上娱乐区的预测。

4-group-7.audio.2.2.textEn: Advection of warmer air will briefly raise temperatures this morning, followed by sleet after dusk.
4-group-7.audio.2.2.textZh: 温暖空气的附着将短暂地提高温度接下来是黄昏后的泥沙。

4-group-7.audio.2.3.textEn: A blizzard is possible at higher elevations, and the avalanche route will remain closed irrespective of conditions in the valley.
4-group-7.audio.2.3.textZh: 在较高海拔地区，暴风雪是可能的，雪崩路线无论河谷的状况如何，都会一直关闭。

4-group-7.audio.2.4.textEn: No tornado warning is currently in effect.
4-group-7.audio.2.4.textZh: 目前没有实施龙卷风警告。

4-group-7.audio.2.5.textEn: Those details matter: a mild afternoon at the lodge does not make the upper trail safe.
4-group-7.audio.2.5.textZh: 这些细节很重要:一个温和的下午在小屋里不能保证上行道的安全。

4-group-7.audio.2.6.textEn: Sailing lessons on the lake will continue until noon, while sledding sessions have been canceled.
4-group-7.audio.2.6.textZh: 湖上的帆船课会一直持续到中午，而滑雪会则被取消。

4-group-7.audio.2.7.textEn: A ranger will update the information board at eleven.
4-group-7.audio.2.7.textZh: 护林员将在 11 点更新告示栏。

4-group-7.audio.2.8.textEn: Please consult that board before you embark on an excursion, and use the marked low-level paths rather than improvising a route.
4-group-7.audio.2.8.textZh: 请在开始远足前咨询那块板子， 并使用标记的低层路径，而不是即兴的路径。

6-passage-group-4.passage.1.7.textEn: Those changes produced tangible benefits, including fewer defects and lower staff turnover.
6-passage-group-4.passage.1.7.textZh: 这些变化产生了实际好处，包括缺陷减少，工作人员更替率降低。

6-passage-group-4.passage.1.8.textEn: The municipal bureau has _____ (145) the project a model for other small businesses.
6-passage-group-4.passage.1.8.textZh: 市政局已将该项目 _____（145）其他小企业的典范。

6-passage-group-4.passage.1.9.textEn: However, the owners reject the idea that a single grant is a panacea.
6-passage-group-4.passage.1.9.textZh: 然而，所有者们拒绝接受单一赠款是一种灵丹妙药的想法。

6-passage-group-4.passage.1.10.textEn: They attribute their progress to sustained collaboration and the willingness to articulate problems clearly.
6-passage-group-4.passage.1.10.textZh: 它们将其进展归因于持续的合作和明确阐明问题的意愿。

6-passage-group-4.passage.1.11.textEn: Applications for the next grant round close on May 16.
6-passage-group-4.passage.1.11.textZh: 下一轮赠款申请于5月16日结束。

6-passage-group-4.passage.1.12.textEn: Businesses _____ (146) wish to apply should request the prospectus and prepare a realistic budget.
6-passage-group-4.passage.1.12.textZh: _____（146）有意申请的企业应索取项目说明书，并制订切实可行的预算。

6-passage-group-4.passage.1.13.textEn: The review panel will publish its criterion for scoring proposals before the deadline.
6-passage-group-4.passage.1.13.textZh: 审查小组将在截止日期之前公布其评分建议的标准。

q143.stem.1.textZh: 哪个动词最能完成143的空白?

q144.option.B.1.textEn: The money was not spent on a promotional campaign.
q144.option.B.1.textZh: 这笔钱没有花在促销运动上。

q144.option.C.1.textZh: 所有学徒都立即被开除。

q144.option.D.1.textEn: The grant was used entirely to purchase advertisements.
